definitions: A monumental arch in Paris, France, commemorating French victories and honoring those who fought and died for France.
A famous avenue in Paris, France, known for its theaters, cafés, and luxury shops, leading to the Arc de Triomphe.
examples: The Arc de Triomphe stands at the western end of the Champs-Élysées.
Tourists often stroll down the Champs-Élysées towards the Arc de Triomphe.
